body:
This is happening because of https://github.com/quarkusio/quarkus/blob/ebee0a4b66d1b4dba9c51165e78d22fbf3b90d3e/extensions/cache/runtime/src/main/java/io/quarkus/cache/runtime/CacheInterceptor.java#L165. 

@mkouba what is the proper pattern to use here?

Thanks a lot @mkouba!

Would you like to go ahead and provide a PR?

> Thanks a lot @mkouba!
> 
> Would you like to go ahead and provide a PR?

For sure! I'll add @gwenneg  for the review.

> OT: It's not exactly clear to name a `@Singleton` implementation `RequestContextKeyGenerator` :D

@mkouba First of all, thank you for your really fast fix! 
You're completely right, that the naming seems a bit off here. Initially the `Singleton` annotation was not present, because I noticed, that the class gets created every time. So, in production, I removed the annotation to skip the whole CDI flow and improve the performance overall.
After this "fix" I created this issue and .. I completely forgot about the class name here :D

issue.title: Cache: only dependent CacheKeyGenerator beans are destroyed after use
issue.body:
- docs - clarify that non-CDI key generators are instantiated per key computation
- fixes #38394
